news.title: Footballer baby name trend takes off after 2026 World Cup: Here’s the most popular choice
news.lede: The FIFA World Cup has always inspired unforgettable moments, but in Peru, one of its biggest impacts is showing up on birth certificates. As Norway's Erling Haaland delivered standout performances at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, hundreds of Peruvian parents honored the striker by naming their newborns after him. According to Peru's National Registry of Identification and Civil Status (RENIEC), the World Cup sparked a noticeable rise in Haaland-inspired names.
